opening.argument: The video presents a deployed contract as an automated profit mechanism: it claims the system will find liquidity, buy ahead of retail investors, sell within one minute, and return 90% to the viewer’s wallet. The instructions then direct viewers to send BNB to the contract and activate it, while portraying larger funding as capable of producing repeated daily returns of up to 100 BNB. Those are concrete financial claims tied to depositing funds, not merely general discussion of trading. Yet the contract’s operation and claimed returns are not independently established; the speaker only reports, “It's already around 15 times.” The combination of requested funding, activation instructions, and extraordinary conditional returns supports the allegation that viewers are being solicited into a deceptive trading opportunity.
